notes: «جميعا عن أبي معاوية» makes the three as co-transmitters of one level. «قال أبو بكر حدثنا أبو معاوية، عن الأعمش، عن شقيق» repeats the same route: one group.
Shaqiq reports a scene with Abdullah and Abu Musa; the dialogue speakers are in the scene, not added as links (rule 6). The saying's transmitter is not separately identified.
